name: weak-hierarchy
about: Drawn by hand, not by our overlay (it cannot plant this): a button-sized 'APPLY' plate fills the middle over the truck's wheels, and the headline is 20-pixel type in the bottom corner.

truth.how: the button is the loudest thing in the ad and the headline can hardly be read

subject_legible.reason: A white semi-truck and trailer rolling down an open highway at sunset is immediately identifiable at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline touts pay-per-mile for OTR driving while the image shows a classic OTR tractor-trailer on the open road — a direct match — but the headline is rendered in tiny text at the bottom corner, making the connection nearly invisible at phone size.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The APPLY button dominates the entire ad in large bold text while the actual headline ($0.65 per mile, Class A OTR.) is relegated to tiny fine print in the bottom corner, completely inverting the intended hierarchy.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep forest-green button matches the brand's primary color (#0B3D2E) and white text matches the secondary color, but there is no logo present anywhere in the ad.
